summary_prompt: Summarize the article in three factual bullet points. Do not invent facts.
Summarize the article for an AI operations analyst.

Return only a valid JSON object grounded in the supplied article. Required keys: summary_v2 (non-empty factual summary string), article_type (string), type_reason (string), policy_entity (array of strings), topic_tags_v2 (array of strings), target_company_type (array of strings), key_facts (object). Use empty arrays/objects when the article provides no evidence. Do not invent facts.
